notes.title: 🚨Tormented Souls 2 demo and new look for Caroline incoming!🚨
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

It’s been quite some time since our last post but today we’re finally ready to share some big news regarding [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464280/Tormented_Souls_2/][b]Tormented Souls 2[/b][/url] which has been selected to feature in the [b]Latin American Games Showcase[/b] taking place on on [b]7th June @ 11am PT / 7pm BST[/b] via [url=https://www.twitch.tv/lagshowcase]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@LAGShowcase]YouTube.[/url]

To celebrate we’ll be releasing a [b]brand new story teaser trailer[/b] during the event which introduces several major characters, and shines the spotlight on the [b]mysterious town[/b] that Caroline will be exploring over the course of the game. Keep an eye out for several never before seen locations 👀 

On top of this we’ll also be revealing an entirely [b]redesigned look for Caroline[/b] which not only reflects feedback we have received since announcement, but also pays tribute to her iconic style from the original [b]Tormented Souls[/b]! We can’t wait to share this with you but for now here’s a sneak peak of our [b]brand-new keyart[/b] (hot of the press!) featuring a familiar looking silhouette 😉  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/f99bd6f63e96d2530d9b4341efd2914ea4118751.jpg[/img]

But that’s not all! We’re proud to announce that our [b]first playable Steam demo[/b] will be available to play the day before the showcase [b]on June 6th at approximately 8am PT / 4pm BST[/b] 🥳This demo will feature the [b]first 60 minutes of gameplay[/b] and will have you navigating the claustrophobic passageways of a sinister convent in search of a gruesome ancient tome…

Lastly, we just wanted to say thank you for your patience and support over the last year. It's been a long road getting to this point, but we’re finally on the home stretch and can’t wait to share more news and information over the coming months as we head towards launch in late 2025 😀

Until next time!

Dual Effect & PQube

notes.title: Celebrate Halloween with a new update and a discount!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Horror Survival Fans[/h2]


Prepare yourselves for jump scares, fiendish puzzles, and a bloody good time!

We're excited to celebrate the spooky season with [b]a brand new update[/b] to Tormented Souls! One of the most requested in-game items for all of you was more [b]outfit options[/b], so we're pleased to show you all the concept art for the [b]new outfit[/b] option for Caroline.

This will be available at the very beginning of the game but that's all we'll tell you, the rest is up to you!
Join us in the Winterlake's mansion and check out the latest items available in-game now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/eb01014eea915ee0e67af1e110b9c02f176fd2f4.png[/img]

We're not ready to fully show you all this [b]new item[/b] but here is an x-ray vision of what's to be discovered once you have completed the game and faced the horrors of the mansion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/f35fd2297beb0fa11f07801197ba34d7e64536cc.png[/img]
To unlock this unique weapon, you'll have to find and solve a new puzzle. Once unlocked, you will still be able to use the weapon after the Halloween event has ended.

One last thing we're happy to announce is the [b]availability of the soundtrack for purchase![/b] You can buy this as a bundle with the game or separately so you can take the ambiance of Tormented Souls [b]wherever you go.[/b]

Before we dive into the updates and patch notes, we’d like to take a moment to thank everyone.

notes.title: New Demo Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/cd71c12ccab075d49fb89ef21dfc6dcdbf2c30c7.png[/img]

[h2]Hello, classic survival horror fans![/h2]

We just want to say [b]thank you so much to everyone[/b] who played the Tormented Souls Demo and we hope you all enjoyed the [b]thrill and mystery[/b] in the Winterlake Mansion. 

We've shown you but a [b]small portion of what to expect[/b] from Caroline's investigation for the twin girls and what lurks in the shadows...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/e54284adb582111705c317f384634031518c7556.gif[/img]

We've listened to your feedback and made [b]improvements[/b] to the overall demo:

[list]
[*] We're excited to announce we have added [b]New languages[/b] to the game: French, Rusian, German and Spanish.

[*] Caroline won't stop when encountering the [b]first enemy in the basement[/b] corridors, making a smoother transition.

[*] New document with [b]controls and instructions[/b] on how to back-dash and reload located in the X-Ray room 

[*] New light in the X-Ray corridor so you won't be [b]consumed by the darkness[/b] when you come back from the generator room.

[*] [b]New monsters trigger dying animation[/b] so you don’t have to waste ammo in order to check if the foes are dead or not.

[*] More [b]visible recording tapes[/b] so you don´t miss them. 

[*] In addition to the wallboard maps, [b]portable maps[/b] have been added so you can check your location whenever you want to avoid getting lost.

[*] Collider issues fixed.

[*] [b]Health items percentage[/b]: Morphine health restores 30% of life and Medical Kit restores 100% 

[*] Compatible with [b]PS5 and PS4 controllers[/b].

[*] Subtitles added to the cinematics.

[*]New Caroline opening cinematic added.
[/list]

notes.content:
Hello again,


We’ve got some exciting news to share with you! 

[u][h3]Closed Beta 2 Update[/h3][/u]
We will be running a Closed Beta for Tormented Souls and we have already received so much interest to help us take the game to the next level. We're sorry that to inform you that since we posted about the Beta yesterday, the dates have now changed to Wednesday 21/04/21 to Saturday 01/05/2021.
Please keep an eye on the Steam page for more information and also for future opportunities to help us test & improve Tormented Souls. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/7d7038c4b7c28dfacd34140b6427f2f6dbac43c8.gif[/img]

[u][h3]Tormented Souls Localisation[/h3][/u]
We've just added in localisation support for multiple different languages, you can now check the store page for the currently supported languages. 
You will be happy to know that the Steam page has been localised in:[list]
[*] Chinese (Simplified) 
[*] Czech
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Italian
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Portuguese
[*] Russian
[*] Spanish[/list]
Welcome to the family!
That’s a great milestone for us as we want players from all around the globe to fully enjoy the game. We've also updated our Steam store page as we thought you would like to get a clearer idea of what to expect when the game ships. 

If you would like your language supported please comment below.

notes.title: Tormented Souls just got better! New Gameplay Snapshot
notes.content:
Hello survival horror fans,


First things first, we would like to thank all the survival horror fans who’ve participated in our first round of beta.  We have received so much useful feedback to help us take the game to the next level. 

We do care about the enthusiasm you've shown us and we are constantly listening to your suggestions in our discord channel. Your feedback is important to us as we want to give you the purest classic survival horror gaming experience you can possibly dream of.

We are excited to release this first view of new in-game  mechanics. This new feature has been requested by many and we’re very happy to make it available to everyone!
Some of you have pointed out that it would be useful to improve the combat mechanics, in order to get a smoother gaming experience. We considered this request and we decided to take action to ensure better experience for players.
The development team are currently working hard on the Beta Build of Tormented Souls - and we wanted to share a short gameplay snapshot with you to show the game's progress so far! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/67f9a112bf2c468f8e90c54a1e4d0c5524b1771a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/b35aa341e8a35ea2abb2b287f4aad3fc77dcd2d7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/b51c6d10b2733f48d01e2381d8ecab77bc5d35d7.gif[/img]

Are you worried that the new features will make the game too easy to enjoy? Rest assured, the improvements won’t change the overall difficulty of the game, neither will it make the experience any less challenging or thrilling.

Thank you once again for your suggestions! The pure and classic survival horror experience has just got more intuitive and player-friendly thanks to your feedback!

https://pqube.co.uk/tormented-souls/
